name: Norco Precision - Metal Fabricator
old_description: Precision machining is essential for producing parts that meet tight tolerances. We deliver high-quality components built to your exact specifications. We ensure each part is produced accurately and efficiently, providing the reliability your projects demand.
about:
Norco Precision, a sheet metal fabricator based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, traces its roots to 1976. The current iteration was launched in 2003 by Phil Nori, a metal fabrication veteran, with a mission to provide top-tier fabrication solutions and customer service. In 2023, ownership expanded to include Brandon Vannelli as president and Matt Hansen as co-owner, growing the team from its original two people to seven.

The company operates as a full-service sheet metal fabricator with in-house capabilities including laser cutting (Mitsubishi 8kW fiber laser), shearing (10' x 1/4" hydraulic shear), forming (up to 12 feet, 170 tons), welding (TIG, MIG, spot, stud), punching, deburring, hardware insertion, and assembly. It also coordinates with local partners for machining, painting, plating, grinding, and additional punching. The shop handles steel, aluminum, and stainless steel up to 1/4-inch thick.

Norco Precision serves medical, automation, restaurant, and packaging industries, producing components such as medical equipment enclosures, structural frames for automation, custom metalwork for restaurants, and packaging machinery parts.

The company emphasizes fast response (first contact within two business days), quality-first stage-gate inspection, and a local-partner approach, aiming to be the "shop down the road" for Twin Cities OEMs.
